model_annotation: This pie chart presents survey results related to the preparedness and qualification of construction professionals (executors/designers) to carry out projects according to the Passive Building (Пасивна сграда) standard, with text in Bulgarian. The chart is divided into four slices, each with percentage labels displayed inside or near the respective segment. The largest slice, shown in green, accounts for 51% and indicates that only a small portion of executors/designers are prepared to implement projects according to the Passive Building standard, while a large number of specialists need training to meet the standard. Two slices each represent 23%: one in red/salmon, stating that only some of the executors/designers are prepared to carry out projects according to the Passive Building standard, and another in olive/dark yellow-green, indicating that there are not enough prepared and qualified specialists for constructing buildings according to the Passive House standard. The smallest slice, shown in blue/purple, represents 3% and corresponds to the view that professionals are prepared and well-qualified to implement projects according to the Passive Building standard. A legend is provided to the right of the chart, matching each color to its corresponding description. The slices appear to be arranged with the dominant 51% segment occupying the lower-center portion of the chart, and no slices appear to be visually exploded or offset from the main body of the pie.
